{{Infobox Slayer |name = Blue dragons |icon = [[File:Blue dragon.png|40px|center]] |skillreq = None |combatreq = {{SCP|Combat|65}} |otherreq = Partial completion of [[Dragon Slayer I]] |vannaka = 40-90 |chaeldar = 70-130 |konar = 120-170 |nieve = 120-185 |duradel = 110-170 |id = No }} [[Blue dragon|Blue dragons]] can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] at level 65 [[Combat level|combat]] by mid- and high-level [[Slayer Master|Slayer masters]] after starting [[Dragon Slayer I]]. They can be found in various caves across [[Gielinor]], with most of them having some requirement to access, such as completion of [[quest]]s, a [[dusty key]], or level 70 [[Agility]]. Blue dragons attack using [[melee]], as well as [[dragonfire]], for which some form of dragonfire protection should be considered. Additionally, [[brutal blue dragon|brutal blue dragons]] can also attack with [[magic]]. Due to their large size, blue dragons can usually be [[safespot]]ted with [[ranged]], [[magic]], or [[halberd]]-like weapons. Like all dragons, they are also susceptible to [[dragonbane]] weapons. When assigned a general task of blue dragons, players who seek a fast task are recommended to bring a [[dwarf multicannon]] to [[Taverley Dungeon]], using it against the [[baby blue dragon]]s in the main dungeon, as the task-only area is full of adults. Players who want slightly more profit are recommended to kill the adult dragons. If players want the maximum profit from the task, it is highly recommended to complete [[Dragon Slayer II]] in order to access [[Vorkath]], who has very consistent and valuable commons. If assigned as a task by [[Konar quo Maten]], it is recommended to skip all tasks that send the player to the [[Ogre Enclave]], [[Catacombs of Kourend]], or [[Ruins of Tapoyauik]]. The dragons in the enclave are very far apart, while the latter two prevent the use of a cannon. It is acceptable if she sends the player to the [[Isle of Souls Dungeon]], as a cannon can be placed there, but the room is filled with both adults and babies. ==Dragonfire== {{:Dragonfire/Chromatic}} ==Monster variants== {|class = "wikitable sortable" !Monster !Combat level !Slayer XP !Locations !Notes |- |[[Baby blue dragon]] |48 |50 | *[[Corsair Cove Dungeon]] *[[Isle of Souls Dungeon]] *[[Taverley Dungeon]] *[[Ruins of Tapoyauik]] *[[Dragon Nest]] | *Weakest variant of blue dragons.
